The '''Shemble-berry''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] native to [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]]. The locals attributed their above-average lifespans to the [[Berry/Legends|berry]].<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|A Berry a Day}}</ref>
